name: a diverged source

⚠ It can't be fast-forwarded. The worktree starts from your local branch, missing commits that are on origin — you may have to rebase or resolve conflicts later.

⚠ The "parent" env strategy needs the source branch checked out to copy its .env; without a worktree it comes from main.
